targets.rawSql: SELECT status, count(*) AS jobs FROM jobs GROUP BY status ORDER BY status
SELECT coalesce(triage, '(waiting)') AS category, count(*) AS emails FROM jobs j LEFT JOIN gate_results g USING (email_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE red_banner) AS "red banner", count(*) FILTER (WHERE needs_human) AS "needs human" FROM gate_results

panels.title: Inbox (newest first): one job per email

targets.rawSql:
SELECT e.id AS email, e.ingested_at AS received, e.from_name AS sender, e.from_addr AS address, e.subject,
  j.status AS job, g.triage, round(g.triage_confidence::numeric, 2) AS confidence, g.language,
  CASE WHEN g.red_banner THEN 'RED: ' || array_to_string(ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(g.reasons)), ' | ') ELSE 'ok' END AS security,
  round(g.injection_score::numeric, 3) AS prompt_guard, e.thread_id AS thread, e.duplicate_of, g.trace_id AS langfuse_trace
FROM emails e JOIN jobs j ON j.email_id = e.id LEFT JOIN gate_results g ON g.email_id = e.id ORDER BY e.id DESC LIMIT 300

SELECT a.email_id AS email, a.filename, a.claimed_type AS "email says", a.true_type AS "really is",
  array_to_string(ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(a.reasons)), ' | ') AS reasons, a.sha256
FROM attachments a WHERE a.verdict = 'quarantined' ORDER BY a.id DESC

panels.title: Hidden text found (never passed to the model)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT g.email_id AS email, h->>'where' AS "where", h->>'text' AS "text (redacted)"
FROM gate_results g, jsonb_array_elements(g.hidden_text) h ORDER BY g.email_id DESC

SELECT count(*) AS "RFQ emails read", sum(parts) AS parts, count(*) FILTER (WHERE needs_human > 0) AS "need a person",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE clarification > 0) AS "ask the customer", count(*) FILTER (WHERE route = 'senior') AS "senior (export control)"
FROM extractions

panels.title: Parts read from drawings and emails (value · source · confidence)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT x.email_id AS email, p->>'part_code' AS part,
  p->'fields'->'material_code'->>'value' AS material, p->'fields'->'material_code'->>'source' AS "material from",
  p->'fields'->'envelope_mm'->>'value' AS "size mm (L, W, H)", p->'fields'->'envelope_mm'->>'source' AS "size from",
  round((p->'fields'->'envelope_mm'->>'confidence')::numeric, 2) AS "size conf",
  coalesce(p->'fields'->'holes_count'->>'value', '') || CASE WHEN p->'fields'->'hole_dia_mm'->>'value' IS NOT NULL THEN ' x Ø' || (p->'fields'->'hole_dia_mm'->>'value') ELSE '' END AS holes,
  p->'fields'->'thread_size'->>'value' AS thread, p->'fields'->'tightest_tolerance_mm'->>'value' AS "tightest tol",
  p->'fields'->'ra_um'->>'value' AS "Ra", p->>'quantities' AS quantities,
  (SELECT string_agg(k, ', ') FROM jsonb_each(p->'fields') f(k, v) WHERE (v->>'needs_human')::boolean) AS "a person checks"
FROM extractions x, jsonb_array_elements(x.result->'parts') p ORDER BY x.email_id DESC, part

SELECT x.email_id AS email, x.language, x.result->'requirements'->'requested_date'->>'value' AS "date",
  x.result->'requirements'->'certificates'->>'value' AS certificates, x.result->'requirements'->'incoterms'->>'value' AS incoterms,
  x.result->'requirements'->'co2_requested'->>'value' AS "CO2?", x.result->'requirements'->'export_control'->>'value' AS "export control",
  x.route, x.llm_calls AS "LLM calls"
FROM extractions x ORDER BY x.email_id DESC

panels.title: Questions for the customer (a draft email; nothing is sent without approval)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT x.email_id AS email, q AS question
FROM extractions x, jsonb_array_elements_text(x.result->'clarification') q ORDER BY x.email_id DESC

panels.title: Estimates (S5): price per break, delivery date, CO2, terms - computed by code, no LLM

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.email_id AS email, s.part_code AS part,
  (SELECT string_agg(b->>'qty' || ' pcs: $' || (b->>'unit_price'), ' | ') FROM jsonb_array_elements(s.result->'breaks') b) AS "price breaks",
  s.result->'delivery'->>'committed' AS committed, s.result->'delivery'->>'p50' AS p50, s.result->'delivery'->>'rush' AS rush,
  s.result->'delivery'->>'bottleneck' AS bottleneck, s.result->'co2'->>'per_part_kg' AS "kg CO2e/part",
  s.result->'terms'->>'validity_date' AS "valid until", s.result->'terms'->'index'->>'series' AS "price index",
  array_to_string(ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(s.result->'flags')), ' | ') AS flags
FROM estimates s ORDER BY s.email_id DESC, part

panels.title: Cost lines of the latest estimate (every number with its source)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT l->>'name' AS line, round((l->>'amount')::numeric, 4) AS "$ per part", l->>'provenance' AS source
FROM (SELECT result FROM estimates ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) s, jsonb_array_elements(s.result->'breaks'->0->'lines') l

panels.title: CO2 lines of the latest estimate (factor, calculation, citation)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT c->>'name' AS contribution, c->>'kg_co2e' AS "kg CO2e", c->>'calc' AS calculation, c->>'source' AS source, c->>'status' AS status
FROM (SELECT result FROM estimates ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) s, jsonb_array_elements(s.result->'co2'->'lines') c
UNION ALL SELECT 'excluded', '', e, 'no citable factor: ask the supplier', '' FROM (SELECT result FROM estimates ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) s,
  jsonb_array_elements_text(s.result->'co2'->'excluded') e

panels.title: Waiting for review (S6: the graph is paused at human_review; nothing is sent without a person)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT j.email_id AS email, e.from_name AS customer, e.subject, j.finished_at AS since,
  (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT s.part_code, ', ') FROM estimates s WHERE s.email_id = j.email_id) AS parts,
  round((SELECT sum(spent_usd) FROM graph_events ge WHERE ge.email_id = j.email_id)::numeric, 5) AS "LLM $"
FROM jobs j JOIN emails e ON e.id = j.email_id WHERE j.status = 'awaiting_review' ORDER BY j.email_id DESC

panels.title: Graph steps per job (every finished node; a resumed job never repeats one)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ge.email_id AS email, ge.node, ge.at, round(ge.spent_usd::numeric, 5) AS "LLM $"
FROM graph_events ge WHERE ge.email_id IN (SELECT email_id FROM graph_events ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 60) ORDER BY ge.email_id DESC, ge.id

SELECT d.email_id AS email, d.action, d.decided_by AS by, d.reason, d.decided_at AS at,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM feedback f WHERE f.email_id = d.email_id) AS edits
FROM decisions d ORDER BY d.decided_at DESC

panels.title: Audit log (S9): every LLM call, tool call, OPA decision, human decision and action, hash-chained

targets.rawSql:
SELECT id, at, kind, actor, email_id AS email,
  coalesce(data->>'event', data->>'rule', data->>'tool', data->>'alias', data->>'approved_action') AS what,
  coalesce(data->>'decision_id', data->>'call_id', data->>'message_id', '') AS ref,
  left(prev_hash, 10) AS prev, left(hash, 10) AS hash
FROM audit_log ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT kind, count(*) AS rows, max(at) AS latest FROM audit_log GROUP BY kind ORDER BY rows DESC

panels.title: Budget alerts (S9): 50 / 80 / 100 % of an agent's 30-day budget

targets.rawSql: SELECT at, agent, threshold AS pct, round(spend_usd::numeric, 4) AS spend_usd, budget_usd FROM budget_alerts ORDER BY at DESC
